audience: small businesses and nonprofits that collect payments and subscriptions with MoonClerk

useCases.title: Find plans that are past due
useCases.text: The AI lists customers (plans) filtered by status, such as past due, unpaid or canceled, with plan amount, interval and next payment date.

useCases.title: List failed or refunded payments
useCases.text: The AI lists payments filtered by status and charge date, with amount, Stripe fee, refunded amount, payer and form.

useCases.title: See which subscriptions bill next week
useCases.text: The AI lists plans filtered by next-payment date range and sums up the amounts due.

useCases.title: Compare how much each payment form collected
useCases.text: The AI lists the payment forms with payment volume and successful checkout count, so you can compare them.

useCases.title: Read one plan or payment in detail
useCases.text: The AI opens one customer plan, with subscription, discount and custom field answers, or one payment, with refunds, payer and coupon.
